t0020-01.gloss: A lesson page and key preserve the dates and household cost of a road closure.
t0020-01.rival_reading: A field crew could have closed the road for work nearby and left the key with a lesson note; nothing here says what forced the closure.

t0020-02.gloss: A lesson moves indoors while a roadside field test continues.
t0020-02.rival_reading: A response crew could have tested roadside treatment after a closure; closed lessons and a prepaid week do not show what the spray was meant to control.
